title: Chords
goal: Add minor 7th chord stabs that move through a 4-bar progression.
explain: chord("<Cm7 Cm7 Ab^7 Bb7>") names one chord per bar and .voicing() turns each symbol into real notes in a sensible register. Use ^7 for major 7th: Strudel does not understand maj7 and silently plays nothing. .struct("~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~") decides when the chord is struck, here on two offbeats per bar. Square waves with a short decay make classic techno stabs.
try_prompt: Add a 4-bar chord progression (Cm7, Cm7, Ab maj7, Bb7) as short offbeat stabs in chords.js.
